assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness, raising concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia.
The service warrants prolonged ambulatory monitoring via Mobile Cardiac Telemetry (CPT 93229).
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction.
The diagnosis codes Z86.73 and I47.1 support the personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction.
The required precertification was not obtained prior to the service date.
The denial is based on Reason Code CO-197.
The underlying medical necessity remains documented in the clinical indication.
